description: This file defines the 'ComponentManagerInterface' TypeScript interface, specifying the methods and imported types related to managing components within the application. It serves as an interface for component management functionalities such as creating viewers, managing components by area, and handling permissions dialogs.

methods.name: urlForComponent(component: SNComponent): string | undefined urlForComponent
methods.description: Returns the URL for a given component, if available.

methods.name: setDesktopManager(desktopManager: DesktopManagerInterface): void setDesktopManager
methods.description: Sets the desktop manager for managing desktop-related functionalities.

methods.name: componentsForArea(area: ComponentArea): SNComponent[] componentsForArea
methods.description: Retrieves all components within a specified area.

methods.name: editorForNote(note: SNNote): SNComponent | undefined editorForNote
methods.description: Retrieves the component editor associated with a specific note.

methods.name: doesEditorChangeRequireAlert(from: SNComponent | undefined, to: SNComponent | undefined): bool/ doesEditorChangeRequireAlert
methods.description: Determines if changing from one editor component to another requires user confirmation.

methods.name: showEditorChangeAlert(): Promise<boolean> showEditorChangeAlert
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog when an editor change requires confirmation, returning user's decision.

methods.name: destroyComponentViewer(viewer: ComponentViewerInterface): void destroyComponentViewer
methods.description: Destroys a specified component viewer instance.

methods.name: createComponentViewer( createComponentViewer
methods.description: Creates a new component viewer for a given component with optional context, observer, and URL override.

methods.name: presentPermissionsDialog(_dialog: PermissionDialog): void presentPermissionsDialog
methods.description: Presents a permissions dialog to the user.

methods.name: legacyGetDefaultEditor(): SNComponent | undefined legacyGetDefaultEditor
methods.description: Retrieves the default editor component in legacy manner.

methods.name: componentWithIdentifier(identifier: FeatureIdentifier | string): SNComponent | undefined componentWithIdentifier
methods.description: Finds a component matching a given identifier.

ctags.name: doesEditorChangeRequireAlert
ctags.pattern: /^  doesEditorChangeRequireAlert(from: SNComponent | undefined, to: SNComponent | undefined): bool/
